runtime.decision: Preserve R4/R5 payload. XeLL marker-without-Present leak and Streamline proxy fixes are already included by version; do not advertise as new R6 fixes.

source_decisions.decision: Retain prior R5 adoption, not a new R6 cherry-pick.
source_decisions.reason: Removes forced borrowed-backbuffer Release loop; no quality/profile changes.
Cleans partial FSR optical-flow/backend construction, resets optional handles, frees failed scratch allocation. No corresponding Intel XeFG allocation path; not evidence of this Dogtown failure.

source_decisions.decision: Correct original inherited control-flow locally; no upstream fix available at this head.
source_decisions.reason: Static lastFormat returns on changed format before updating remembered value; tag result !=SUCCESS enters fgChanged/Deactivate loop. These mechanisms remain in latest upstream. Whether Dogtown triggered either is unproven by R5 logs.

rules: Guide L656-657,890-893: disabling marks history cleanup for next enable and prevents history retention. Disabled tag success alone cannot prove retained inputs or recovery; no explicit guarantee of disabled tagging persistence was found.
Guide L883-893: resetHistory skips only current interpolation while retaining current-frame inputs. Avoid treating expected scene-history reset as a permanent provider failure.
Guide L1016-1022,1106-1108: submit tagging command lists and finish input/PresentId calls before matching Present.

Guide L1112-1137: positive return codes are warnings, negative codes errors. Warning RESOURCE_SIZES_MISMATCH=6 explicitly skips interpolation; warning does not prove a coherent frame or require a permanent fault.

Header L300-308 and guide L1032-1053: last status has framesPresented, frameGenResult and isFrameGenEnabled. framesPresented includes rendered frames; every Present including DXGI_PRESENT_TEST updates status. API success alone is not generated-frame proof.
Guide L860: Hudless texture format must match backbuffer. No process-global immutable format requirement was found; input transitions still need current-frame consistency.
Guide L1058-1084: resize/destroy require tagging-work completion and no concurrent context use. Recovery must retain R5 lifetime protections.

Header L463-483: initial maxInterpolatedFrames bounds later selection; frequent SetNumInterpolatedFrames may compile/reallocate. Retain initialized 6x capability; required heap sizes are not measured resident allocation.

issue_evidence.finding: Old FSR-mod Dogtown counter-versus-smoothness anecdote; not the same provider/runtime and no verified transferable patch.
Witcher 3 Linux/OptiFG 0.7.9 degradation report; different OS/input/runtime. No code-backed fix for current path.
Battlefield 6 leak report closed with developer-fix comment; no source patch establishing applicability to this custom Cyberpunk path.

limits: No reviewed upstream change proves or fully fixes the user-specific Dogtown reproduction. New local fixes must be tested and clearly separated from hypotheses.

R5 LOCAL usage exceeds its budget while native Present delays grow; process-wide counters do not identify engine, driver or provider ownership. No proven automatic eviction or RAM-spill fix is adopted.
Preserve shaders, upscaler binary/profile, ratio 1.5, color/HDR/exposure behavior, default 3x and maximum 6x unlock; exclude DLSS5 and extra mod stacking.
Final production diff, artifact hashes and test status are recorded separately; this review does not assert unrun gameplay tests.

memory_contracts.finding: Microsoft documents possible stuttering and performance penalties when application CurrentUsage exceeds Budget. This supports a pressure hypothesis, not ownership or a proven leak.
Over-budget residency can intermittently freeze the process. Moving frequently used resources to system memory can severely reduce FPS; no simple API identifies safely spillable engine resources.

local_source_corrections.name: FFX context routing registry synchronization
evidence: OptiScaler/upscalers/FeatureProvider_Dx12.cpp:143 moves the old feature into DelayedDestroy.
OptiScaler/Util.h:61-63 destroys it on a detached worker after two seconds.
OptiScaler/proxies/FfxApi_Proxy.h previously read/inserted/erased the same ankerl map without synchronization. Foreground create/configure and other delayed destroy workers can overlap.
local_source_corrections.implementation: FfxContextRegistry retains the existing map type; short locks serialize Set/Find/atomic Take. External provider calls stay outside locks. Original dispatch/fallback and quality settings are unchanged.
local_source_corrections.validation: tests/r6_ffx_registry compiles the production helper and exercises 16000 concurrent context lifetimes, single-winner removal and fallback semantics. Final aggregate results are in TEST_RESULTS.json.
local_source_corrections.limit: Concrete source data race corrected; R5 log does not establish that this race occurred at Dogtown or caused its memory growth.
